components.label: Real-rate pressure
components.description: Higher real yields increase the real cost of capital and tighten duration-sensitive financial conditions.

components.label: Long-end yield pressure
components.description: Higher long-term Treasury yields tighten financing conditions for duration-sensitive borrowers and assets.

components.label: Dollar pressure
components.description: A stronger broad U.S. dollar can tighten global dollar funding and external financial conditions.

components.label: Commercial-paper spread
components.description: The AA nonfinancial commercial-paper premium over Treasury bills is a direct short-term credit and funding signal.

components.label: Overnight funding spread
components.description: SOFR relative to the administered reserve rate captures pressure in secured overnight funding.

components.label: Reserve-liquidity pressure
components.description: Falling reserve balances increase the liquidity-pressure contribution to the index.

components.label: Yield-curve inversion
components.description: A more inverted 2s10s curve is treated as a tighter policy and credit-cycle configuration.

sourceHealth.name: Secured Overnight Financing Rate
sourceHealth.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

sourceHealth.name: Reserve Balances with Federal Reserve Banks

methodology.name: BondStats Financial Conditions Index
methodology.scale: 0–100; higher values indicate tighter financial conditions
methodology.normalization: Rolling two-year z-scores, winsorized to ±3 standard deviations
methodology.mapping: Composite z-score mapped to a 0–100 scale centered on 50
